# 0x0800 SRL | Denis Leclercq

> On-premise, sovereign AI for SMBs and mid-market companies | Local agents on your data, RGPD & EU AI Act compliant

## About

0x0800 SRL (Denis Leclercq, Liège, Belgium, BCE: BE1021845609) deploys AI agents that run locally inside the company, on the client's own hardware. The data never leaves the premises. The pitch is sovereignty and compliance: RGPD and the EU AI Act, for PME and ETI (SMBs and mid-market) in Belgium and France that want agentic AI but do not know where to start. The deployed product is Hygur. 0x0800 also sells the inference hardware (rent or buy) and training. Backed by 20 years of infrastructure experience.

## Offers

- Scoping workshop (Atelier de cadrage IA): one day on site, use-case prioritisation, EU AI Act classification, RGPD readiness, roadmap and quote. From 1,500 EUR (deducted from a deployment).
- Hygur on-premise deployment: pilot from 5,900 EUR (one use case, one data source); production on quote, from 15,000 EUR.
- Inference hardware (rent or buy, 24-month rental with purchase option): AMD Strix Halo (128 GB) from 3,900 EUR / 229 EUR per month; NVIDIA DGX Spark (128 GB) from 5,500 EUR / 329 EUR per month; GPU in your own server (RTX 5090/6000) from 2,500 EUR / 149 EUR per month.
- Training (intra-company): half-day from 950 EUR, full day from 1,700 EUR.
- Support & maintenance: Essentiel from 149 EUR per month, Supervision from 490 EUR per month.
- One-off missions (secondary): cloud audit, sovereign architecture, fractional CTO. Day rate on request.

All prices are indicative and exclude tax.

## Products

- Hygur (https://hygur.ai): Local-first personal AI. Data stays on the machine, the model comes to it. The product deployed on-premise in companies. Local edition and multi-tenant sovereign cloud. Hygur Cloud: personal from 29 EUR per month, team on quote.
- CompliMetric (https://complimetric.com): Continuous cloud compliance. Scans cloud and IaC, detects drift, produces NIS2 / ISO 27001 evidence. SaaS + GitHub Action + MCP server.
